title: Best dental clinics in Buenos Aires

methodology.note: Public-evidence ranking of general-care dental clinics in CABA. Clinics are scored on published equipment first. English is a badge and filter only — it does not change the score. Reviews are a 10-point tie-break.

weights.name: Equipment
weights.note: Only kit named on the official site, Google listing, or Doctoralia. Digital intraoral X-ray / RVG 8, panoramic 7, intraoral scanner 8, CAD/CAM 8, intraoral camera 4, named whitening system 5, generic LED whitening 3, ultrasonic prophylaxis 3, CBCT 6, in-house lab 6.

weights.name: General-care fit
weights.note: Explicit limpieza / profilaxis, obturaciones / caries, and blanqueamiento. Implants and ortho are extras, not substitutes.

weights.name: Transparency
weights.note: Confirmable address, hours, booking path, and named dentists.

weights.name: Review signal
weights.note: Tie-break only. Volume cannot outrank a better-equipped clinic.

validation.source: Spanish-first discovery by CABA zone, then one clinic audit each from official sites, Google Maps, Doctoralia, and AgendaPro
validation.scope: CABA general-care clinics that publicly offer cleaning and fillings. Curated shortlist, not a directory of every consultorio.
validation.lastTop5AuditNote: Rescored for equipment-first general care. Veneer, All-on-X, implant-boutique, and hospital cartilla desks were dropped. Previously excluded Spanish clinics (Dental System, Congreso Dental, Dental Ciudad, Dental Woda, IOAT, SM) were re-audited.

clinics.name: IOAT — Instituto Odontológico de Alta Tecnología
clinics.fullAddress: Paraná 749 4º, C1017AAO CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: Online turnero or WhatsApp for a first evaluation.
clinics.bestFor: Routine cleaning, fillings, and whitening in a downtown clinic with named digital kit.
clinics.notes: More than 40 dentists and 10 consultorios. Site names CAD/CAM, VistaVox CBCT, panoramic, digital X-ray, intraoral scanner, and camera.
clinics.caution: Google is 4.1 from a large sample — useful for kit, not a boutique rating.

englishSupport.label: No official English found
englishSupport.evidence: Official site and booking path are Spanish-only.

clinics.insuranceNote: Confirm prepaga coverage on WhatsApp before the visit.

clinics.name: Dental System Recoleta
clinics.fullAddress: Talcahuano 1134, C1013AAX CABA, Argentina
clinics.bookingLead: Central de turnos 5235-3333 or WhatsApp.
clinics.bestFor: A large Recoleta HQ with CAD/CAM lab, CBCT, and general dentistry across several CABA sedes.
clinics.notes: Sede central: 8 consultorios, digital radiology, CAD/CAM lab, and an OR. Other CABA sedes in Caballito, Almagro, Barracas, and Belgrano.

clinics.insuranceNote: Ask the central de turnos which prepagas this sede accepts.

clinics.insuranceNote: OSDE, Galeno, Swiss Medical, Medicus, Apross, OSPJN, plus particulares. Confirm the procedure.
